Result tables

Source: R/result-tables.R
result_tables.Rd

A merchandising result records cuts, quantities, deductions, and calculation choices. Supply tree measurements and product specifications to merchandise or optimize_bucking. Use product_summary for grouped totals.

Details

A merch_result contains measurement tables and a run_metadata list. Shared fields keep the same meaning wherever they appear. Returned fields are calculated or copied from inputs, so they have no input default to fill.

There are no list columns in the result tables. Nested objects occur in the recorded settings.

Length means feet in imperial calls and meters in metric calls. Diameter means inches or centimeters. Physical volume means cubic feet or cubic meters.

The suffix ib means inside bark and ob means outside bark. Scaled quantities use their own declared units. Values use the supplied currency.

No currency conversion or inventory expansion is performed. Output is not rounded for display beyond the scaling procedure's rounding.

Contents

ElementRows and purposeKeys
logsOne row per selected log. Ordered by input tree and cutting order.id and log
treesOne row per input tree, including trees with no logs. Input order is retained.id
scalesOne row per log and measured procedure, including additional reports.id, log, measurement fields, and name when present
residualsNonoverlapping intervals allocated outside selected logs.id and interval endpoints
defect_accountingOne row per selected log, with located and later physical deductions.id and log
valuesOne row per log when prices are active. Empty with defined columns otherwise.id and log
run_metadataA list of recorded settings and inputs for interpreting and repeating the run.Not a table
diagnosticsPresent with status = TRUE. One row per tree with a nonzero status.id

Shared identifiers

ColumnTypeUnitMeaning
idInput atomic typeNoneTree identifier retained from the call. Join tables by this identifier, not by row position.
logIntegerNoneLog number within a tree, starting at one in cutting order.
productCharacterNoneAssigned product name from the specification.
statusIntegerNoneTree calculation code, present in logs and trees with status = TRUE. Log rows carry their tree status. Also present in diagnostics. See Status and missing values below.
segmentIntegerNoneUsable stem section index in logs and residuals. This is not an inventory plot identifier.

Log dimensions and specification

ColumnTypeUnitMeaning
treeIntegerNoneInput tree row position.
stageIntegerNonePosition in the reachable product sequence.
product_indexIntegerNoneRow position in the ordered calculation specifications.
priorityIntegerNoneAssigned product priority.
gradeCharacterNoneRetained descriptive grade. Defaults to the product name when no grade was supplied. Does not establish an independently assigned grade.
length_kindCharacterNone'ordinary' for an accepted listed or range length, or 'boundary' for a permitted short log ending at an eligible boundary.
start_heightNumericLengthHeight at the log butt. Heights are above ground.
nominal_end_heightNumericLengthHeight at the nominal end, before trim. Heights are above ground.
end_heightNumericLengthHeight at the physical cut, after trim. Heights are above ground.
nominal_lengthNumericLengthLength of the nominal log body.
physical_lengthNumericLengthNominal length plus trim.
trimNumericLengthExtra physical length beyond the nominal end.
led_ibNumericDiameterLarge-end diameter inside bark at the log butt. Raw diameter before scaling rounding. Unavailable values are missing.
sed_ibNumericDiameterSmall-end diameter inside bark at the physical cut. Raw diameter before scaling rounding. Unavailable values are missing.
led_obNumericDiameterLarge-end diameter outside bark at the log butt. Raw diameter before scaling rounding. Unavailable values are missing.
sed_obNumericDiameterSmall-end diameter outside bark at the physical cut. Raw diameter before scaling rounding. Unavailable values are missing.
diameter_basisCharacterNone'ib' or 'ob', identifying the bark basis used for acceptance.

Physical log quantities

ColumnTypeUnitMeaning
log_gross_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumePhysical log volume before deductions, including trim inside bark.
log_gross_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumePhysical log volume before deductions, including trim outside bark.
located_deduction_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeLocated physical deduction inside bark. Summed by tree in trees. Also reported in defect_accounting.
located_deduction_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumeLocated physical deduction outside bark. Summed by tree in trees. Also reported in defect_accounting.
log_located_net_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumePhysical log volume remaining after located deductions inside bark.
log_located_net_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumePhysical log volume remaining after located deductions outside bark.
posthoc_deduction_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeLater percentage deduction inside bark. Summed by tree in trees. Also reported in defect_accounting.
posthoc_deduction_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumeLater percentage deduction outside bark. Summed by tree in trees. Also reported in defect_accounting.
log_net_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeFinal physical log volume after all deductions inside bark. Summed by tree in trees.
log_net_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumeFinal physical log volume after all deductions outside bark. Summed by tree in trees.
rot_pctNumericPercentLocated rot deduction as a percentage of gross physical inside-bark log volume. Zero means no located rot deduction.
trim_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeInside-bark trim volume, already included in gross physical log volume. Do not add it again.

Product and reporting quantities

ColumnTypeUnitMeaning
volume_unitCharacterNoneProduct measurement unit. See Scaling rules.
scale_ruleCharacterNoneScaling procedure in logs or measured procedure in scales. See Scaling rules.
measurement_quantityCharacterNoneQuantity family in logs, board_foot, cubic, green_weight, or cord. See Scaling rules.
scale_unitCharacterNoneUnit of scaled quantities in logs. See Scaling rules.
scale_bark_basisCharacterNoneMeasurement bark basis in logs, ib or ob. See Scaling rules.
unitCharacterNoneMeasurement unit in scales. See Scaling rules.
bark_basisCharacterNoneMeasurement bark basis in scales, ib or ob. See Scaling rules.
gross_scaleNumericscale_unitGross scaled quantity. Unavailable quantity is missing.
located_net_scaleNumericscale_unitScaled quantity after located deductions. Unavailable quantity is missing.
net_scaleNumericscale_unitFinal scaled quantity after all deductions. Unavailable quantity is missing.
grossNumericunitGross measured quantity in scales. Unavailable quantities remain missing.
located_netNumericunitQuantity after located deductions in scales. Unavailable quantities remain missing.
located_deductionNumericunitGross minus quantity after located deductions in scales. Unavailable quantities remain missing.
posthoc_deductionNumericunitLater percentage deduction in scales. Unavailable quantities remain missing.
netNumericunitFinal quantity after all deductions in scales. Unavailable quantities remain missing.
is_productLogicalNoneTRUE for the assigned product scaling measurement, FALSE for an additional report.
nameCharacterNonePresent when named report_also definitions are used. Product rows are labeled 'product'. Other rows retain the supplied reporting name.

Tree inputs and totals

ColumnTypeUnitMeaning
dbhNumericDiameterSupplied outside-bark diameter at breast height.
htNumericLengthSupplied total height above ground.
modelCharacterNoneResolved taper equation identifier.
spcdIntegerNoneResolved Forest Inventory and Analysis species code, present in trees when species were supplied and in diagnostics.
ageNumericYearsSupplied tree age, present only when supplied.
prunedLogicalNoneSupplied pruning state, present only when supplied.
stump_heightNumericLengthResolved stump height above ground.
utilization_heightNumericLengthResolved utilization limit above ground after height, diameter, and break limits.
log_countIntegerLogsCount of selected logs.
gross_stem_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeModeled volume from ground to tip inside bark.
gross_stem_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumeModeled volume from ground to tip outside bark.
stump_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeStump allocation inside bark.
stump_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumeStump allocation outside bark.
top_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeTop allocation including short remainders, diameter limits, and product failures inside bark.
top_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumeTop allocation including short remainders, diameter limits, and product failures outside bark.
cull_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeCulled allocation inside bark.
cull_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumeCulled allocation outside bark.
break_cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeModeled stem above a recorded break inside bark.
break_cubic_obNumericPhysical volumeModeled stem above a recorded break outside bark.
reconciled_cubic_ibLogicalNoneWhether net logs, residual allocations, and deductions sum to gross stem volume inside bark. Missing when the check is unavailable. Tolerance is 1e-8 times the larger of one and gross volume. This tests accounting, not predictive accuracy.
reconciled_cubic_obLogicalNoneWhether net logs, residual allocations, and deductions sum to gross stem volume outside bark. Missing when the check is unavailable. Tolerance is 1e-8 times the larger of one and gross volume. This tests accounting, not predictive accuracy.

Residual intervals

ColumnTypeUnitMeaning
fromNumericLengthLower endpoint above ground.
toNumericLengthUpper endpoint above ground.
causeCharacterNone'stump', 'top', 'cull', 'break', 'short_remainder', 'diameter_limit', or 'product_failure'. The final three explain unallocated usable stem.
cubic_ibNumericPhysical volumeResidual interval volume inside bark.
cubic_obNumericPhysical volumeResidual interval volume outside bark.

Monetary values

ColumnTypeUnitMeaning
currencyCharacterNoneSupplied currency label in values, such as 'USD' for United States dollars.
gross_valueNumericCurrencyGross quantity times price divided by price_per. Appears in values and logs, and is summed in trees when pricing is active. Unpriced logs receive zero. Unavailable priced quantity gives missing value.
located_net_valueNumericCurrencyValue after located deductions. Appears in values and logs, and is summed in trees when pricing is active. Unpriced logs receive zero. Unavailable priced quantity gives missing value.
located_deduction_valueNumericCurrencyGross value minus value after located deductions. Appears in values and logs, and is summed in trees when pricing is active. Unpriced logs receive zero. Unavailable priced quantity gives missing value.
posthoc_deduction_valueNumericCurrencyLater percentage deduction in value. Appears in values and logs, and is summed in trees when pricing is active. Unpriced logs receive zero. Unavailable priced quantity gives missing value.
net_valueNumericCurrencyFinal value after all deductions. Appears in values and logs, and is summed in trees when pricing is active. Unpriced logs receive zero. Unavailable priced quantity gives missing value.

Diagnoses

ColumnTypeUnitMeaning
speciesCharacterNoneResolved common species name in diagnostics. Missing if unresolved.
status_nameCharacterNoneName corresponding to the integer diagnosis in diagnostics.

Recorded settings

ElementTypeMeaning
contract_versionCharacterRecorded result contract label.
unitsCharacterInput and physical measurement system, imperial or metric.
algorithmCharacter'cascade' records longest-log selection. 'dp' records optimization.
objectiveCharacterEffective objective, value or net_cubic_ib.
unpricedCharacterPolicy for unpriced products during value optimization.
model_vector_hashCharacterIdentifier for the ordered equation choices.
taper_manifestData frameRecord of equations available during the call. Its fields are described by taper_manifest.
provider_generationNumericSession equation-state identifier. Missing when no calculation session was needed.
nvel_source_revisionCharacterRecorded source-library revision.
products_hashCharacterIdentifier for the calculation product specifications.
posthoc_callsData frameLater deduction calls, with integer call_seq for order, character kind for the supplied reason, and numeric percent from zero through 100. A varying log percentage records a missing scalar percent.
assumptionsData frameRecorded choices and their sources. Every field is described by assumptions.
callListResolved inputs needed to repeat the calculation. Names follow merchandise, with additional equation inputs. The stored scaling element contains reporting definitions and products retains expanded source settings.
front_doorListPresent when automatic geographic settings were used. The fields are listed in the corresponding section.

All scalar identifiers and policy labels are unitless. Stored call measurements retain the call's units. Identifiers do not contain private equation coefficients or certify validity. Save local models and input data separately.

The optional front_door list stores the geographic label in character region. Integer nvel_region, forest, and district store agency codes. Character preset names automatically selected example products and is missing when products were supplied.

Logical model_assumed and products_assumed record automatic choices. Character model_source distinguishes caller_model, caller_taper_map, and nvel_default. Logical taper_map_ignored records whether an explicit model took precedence. All these fields are unitless.

Status and missing values

ok means completion. no_feasible_log means a valid result with no logs under the specifications. Other codes require review before totals are reported.

Failed trees can retain partial logs, so a log row does not establish a complete calculation. status_codes lists codes, meanings, and sources.

Unavailable physical or scaled quantities remain missing. Outside-bark missing values are not zeros. Zero deductions mean no deduction at that stage.

Some failed-tree totals are zero because no logs were selected. Always read the tree status before interpreting a zero total. status = FALSE omits status columns and reports nonzero tree statuses in warnings.

status = TRUE keeps diagnoses and suppresses those warnings. Structural input errors still stop the call. Use na_action = 'propagate' in product_summary when an incomplete sum should remain missing.

Value

The result list retains cuts, quantities, deductions, and recorded settings in the structures listed in the corresponding section.

See also

merchandise for longest-log selection, optimize_bucking for value or cubic optimization, and assumptions for recorded choices.

Examples

## Calculate logs for the shipped tree list
result <- merchandise(dbh = example_trees$dbh,
                      ht = example_trees$ht,
                      model = example_trees$model,
                      species = example_trees$species,
                      products = example_products(name = 'pnw'),
                      status = TRUE)

## Inspect the result
product_summary(x = result, table = 'trees')
